name: mission-ranger
about: Full-build fixture over the MECHANICS.md section 8 run-state schema: a level-20 ranger (experience 1301032, the level cap: GiveExperience(5000000) stopped there), every placeable attribute point in Dex (picked-dex 57), a character flag, ilvl-20 t3 gear in the three starting slots (bow, chest, feet; t4 at ilvl 20 is refused by MayEquip), the apothecary's potion-charges upgrade at step 4 (5 charges), all through the game's own functions (gamelab-hands Build.as). Why level 20: enemy health and armour scale with NG+ only, not with the player's level (CompositeActorBehavior.as:335-337, 718-719). The level-5 build died to a 13-enemy beetle and wasp swarm on dark_citadel floor 0 (pilot-crosslevel 20261017-160229), and so did a level-12 t2 build (20261017-160659). Materials given in town go to the town store (measured, fixture-ranger 20261017-152033), so they are read back from the town record. Every field below is read back through `inspect`; a mismatch fails the run. Values measured in fixture-ranger 20261017-160925. Item hashes are HashString of the base item id (gamelab/hps.py), and the saved item array is [quality, baseHash, intensity, ilvl, upgrade, colorA, colorB, mods...] (Items/Equipment.as:183-200). Quality: a 'rare' mask gave quality 2 for t1 items (20261017-151727) and 4 for t2/t3 items; the generator's RollQuality ignores a mask without the Common bit (RE_NOTES), so the quality comes from elsewhere (assumed: the base item's own quality). The dash-charges probe was dropped on 2026-10-25: dashCharges recharges after the load (MECHANICS.md section 8 marks it non-persistent) and read 0 one second after the town loaded (fix-recaps 20261025-231047).
